text: SERVICE AGREEMENT
This Service Agreement (the "Agreement") is made on 1 March 2026 between Northwind Analytics AS, Oslo, Norway (the "Supplier"), and Riverbank Logistics Ltd, Leeds, United Kingdom (the "Customer").
1. Services
1.1 The Supplier shall provide hosting, monitoring and support for the data platform of the Customer, as described in this Agreement.
1.2 Support is available on business days from 08:00 to 18:00 CET. Critical incidents are answered within 2 hours.
2. Fees and Payment
2.1 The Customer shall pay the monthly fees in Table 1. The fees exclude VAT.

text: 3. Term and Termination
3.1 This Agreement has an initial term of 24 months. It renews automatically for successive periods of 12 months, unless terminated.
3.2 Either party may terminate this Agreement by written notice of at least 90 days before the end of the current term.
3.3 The Supplier may suspend the services if an invoice is more than 45 days overdue.
4. Liability
4.1 The total liability of the Supplier is limited to the fees paid in the 12 months before the claim. Neither party is liable for:
indirect or consequential losses;
loss of profit or revenue;
loss of data, except where caused by a breach of the backup obligations of the Supplier.
5. Governing Law
5.1 This Agreement is governed by the laws of Norway. Disputes are settled by the Oslo District Court.
